facts.fact: Webdo reports that the Ministry of Communication Technologies launched national tender 02/2025 to extend telecom and broadband coverage to 103 white zones in 15 governorates.
Webdo reports that the 2017 white-zones project, with Tunisie Telecom alone, connected 94 white zones, 164 schools and 59 health centres, benefiting over 180,000 citizens.
